item.title: Exploring the Beauty of the Breakdown | Caoimhe Heaney (Anecdotes Issue 01)
item.description: Caoimhe Heaney reflects on the beauty of the breakdown—how painful change can reveal growth, meaning, and quiet strength. Layered photomontages hold space for imperfection, vulnerability, and the fragile beauty that emerges when we allow ourselves to transform.

item.title: Censorship and Iconoclasm in Art: Fear, Power, and Expression | Lucy Lambe (Anecdotes Issue 01)
item.description: Lucy Lambe examines censorship and iconoclasm as responses to art’s agency—tracing image destruction, moral panic, and institutional control from Michelangelo to contemporary controversies. A sharp look at fear, power, sexuality, and why art’s ability to disturb is part of its purpose.
